remaining_photoreal_defects: Both rivers still read as opaque dark surfaces rather than deep refractive water volumes in the near field.
Named rapid holes, rollers, standing waves, aeration, spray, mist, and rock-impact plumes remain understated.
The separate capture-only foam carrier is sparse and is not yet proven against raft and passenger occlusion in these two maps.

Thirty-metre terrain remains too smooth for reach-specific shelves, undercuts, fine cobble bars, scarps, and rapid rocks; the new structures are explicit procedural sub-DEM gap fill, not a resolution replacement.
The project-owned conifer, broadleaf, shrub, and ground-cover forms remain visibly procedural and repetitive.
Roots, deadwood, leaf litter, fine gravel, deposited sediment, terrain-integrated wetness, and river-specific geology remain incomplete.
Cooked hydraulics remain unconverged and uncalibrated against observed Terminator and Lava Canyon behavior.
No named local guide, geospatial reviewer, environment artist, water-VFX reviewer, or target-hardware performance reviewer has accepted either result.
